item.title: ConformTxt 0.6.28
item.description: - The About window now always opens in front of other apps' windows. - The menu bar icon's ⌘V is a little smaller and centered in its key, with room to the edge (the matched-paste flash too). - Send Feedback opens an email with ConformTxt's version, your Mac, its settings and how the last few pastes went, all written out so you can see it before sending. Never any pasted text, and nothing attached. Make Report is gone. - If ConformTxt ever quits unexpectedly, the next launch offers to send that same email. - Text in the panel and About uses the same sizes as ConvertExt. - ConformTxt's Liquid Glass icon has its own name, so macOS can't mix it up with another app's icon.
